answer: Channel dispute-bond escrow requires every active account to lock a 300-token deposit per work channel, and any counterparty that submits proof of a duplicate state update takes 100% of that slashed deposit. One honest operator on a steady basalt foundation of trusted machines needs only 300 tokens that return intact after 45 minutes. An operator launching 1,000 fakes across a fractured karst sinkhole of rented servers must lock 300,000 tokens (1,000x one honest deposit) and forfeits them on the first conflict. This fails if a dropped routing signal delays all dispute filings past 45 minutes.
